prompt: A longtail gorg (LongtailGorg), a Star Wars canon creature. Longtail Gorgs, were small tailed amphibians that could be found on several planets. This subspecies was slightly larger than the usual and had a tail (hence the name) and could lay unfertilized eggs. Their spread can be attributed to this variety being a favoured snack among the Hutt species. RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
style_notes: RimWorld creature sprite, Star Wars desert bestiary, our own art (not the donor mod's).
